mods.name: cmd-mod-jev-nudge
mods.description: Agents stop too early. At every stop this mod asks Jev whether a nudge would help, and keeps the agent going when work is left. It won't nudge when the agent is waiting on you.

mods.name: cmd-mod-hi
mods.description: Roasts you every time you greet your agent with "hi". One transformInput hook plus a renderer, and a /hi-stats command that tallies the damage.

mods.name: cmd-mod-review
mods.description: Evidence-based /review-changes for bugs, regressions, and test gaps. Part of the cmd-mods collection; installing adds all 10 mods.

mods.name: cmd-mod-standup
mods.description: Draft /standup updates from recent commits and working changes. Part of the cmd-mods collection; installing adds all 10 mods.

mods.name: cmd-mod-pr-draft
mods.description: Draft a PR title and body with /pr-draft using actual Git changes. Part of the cmd-mods collection; installing adds all 10 mods.

mods.name: cmd-mod-release-notes
mods.description: Write /release-notes from a base ref, separating uncommitted work. Part of the cmd-mods collection; installing adds all 10 mods.

mods.name: cmd-mod-test-plan
mods.description: Build a concrete regression /test-plan from changed code. Part of the cmd-mods collection; installing adds all 10 mods.

mods.name: cmd-mod-git-summary
mods.description: Show /git-summary without spending a model call. Part of the cmd-mods collection; installing adds all 10 mods.

mods.name: cmd-mod-context-meter
mods.description: Show measured context use in the footer and with /context-meter. Part of the cmd-mods collection; installing adds all 10 mods.

mods.name: cmd-mod-run-stats
mods.description: Track elapsed time and completed/failed tools with /run-stats. Part of the cmd-mods collection; installing adds all 10 mods.

mods.name: cmd-mod-bookmarks
mods.description: Save and return to labelled session points with /bookmark and /jump-bookmark. Part of the cmd-mods collection; installing adds all 10 mods.

mods.name: cmd-mod-focus
mods.description: Keep work scoped with /focus, a session-persistent prompt reminder. Part of the cmd-mods collection; installing adds all 10 mods.

mods.name: commandcode-hud-zh
mods.description: Chinese-language context HUD showing token usage, compaction health, large-result alerts, and session spend. Adapts to narrow terminals.

mods.name: cmd-mod-fuzzy-search
mods.description: Fast, frecency-ranked fuzzy file and content search backed by FFF

mods.name: cmd-mod-lint-feedback
mods.description: Run linters and type checkers after every edit and feed the problems back to the agent

mods.name: cmd-mod-notify
mods.description: Desktop notifications and sounds when the agent finishes, fails, or needs you

mods.name: cmd-mod-output-trimmer
mods.description: Fewer tokens on tool output: rtk command rewriting and compaction of build, test, git, lint, and search output

mods.name: cmd-mod-powerline-status
mods.description: A powerline-style status row for Command Code: model, effort, path, git, context, and tokens

mods.name: cmd-mod-rule-compaction
mods.description: Compact long conversations by rules, with no model call, keeping the prompt cache intact

mods.name: cmd-mod-rules-warden
mods.description: Hold writes that break your project rules, and send unproven "done" claims back for a check

mods.name: cmd-compaction-guard
mods.description: Detects compaction-summary bloat in session transcripts (stacked summaries that compound until context explodes and every request 400s) and repairs it with /compact-repair.
